error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the BlueBubbles server. Please check the host and your network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication. Please check your password.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Please try again and check the logs if the problem persists.

init.title: BlueBubbles inbound messaging
init.description: Enable inbound messages so Home Assistant can trigger automations from iMessage/SMS. Webhook path: `{webhook_path}`. Point BlueBubbles at your Home Assistant base URL plus that path (auto-register does this when possible).

data.webhook_local_only: Accept webhooks from local network only
data.include_from_me: Also trigger on messages sent from this Mac (isFromMe)
data.allowed_handles: Allowed senders (optional, comma-separated phones/emails; empty = all)

data_description.enable_inbound: Registers a Home Assistant webhook and fires BlueBubbles triggers for new messages. Triggers stay visible even when this is off; they simply will not fire until inbound is enabled.
data_description.auto_register_webhook: Calls the BlueBubbles /api/v1/webhook API using your Home Assistant URL.
data_description.webhook_local_only: Recommended when BlueBubbles and Home Assistant share a LAN.
data_description.include_from_me: Off by default so your own outbound messages do not fire automations.

message_received.name: Message received
message_received.description: Triggers when one or more BlueBubbles messages are received.

phrase_received.name: Phrase received
phrase_received.description: Triggers when one or more BlueBubbles messages match a phrase.

phrase.name: Phrase
phrase.description: Text to match against the inbound message body.

match_type.name: Match type
match_type.description: How the phrase is compared to the message text.
